Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production character expression sprite for a Chinese visual novel.
Input image 1 is the ONLY identity, body, clothing, pose, proportions, framing, painting-style and color reference, called Option D. Make a 1024 x 1536 portrait PNG with a genuinely transparent background.

It is a sincere everyday smile, not a smirk. Preserve his specific irregular natural East Asian facial structure exactly: narrow gently oblong face, natural slightly asymmetrical almond eyes, flat natural eyebrows, rounded natural nose, relaxed relatively full lips, slim jaw and very subtle chin stubble. He must remain visibly the identical specific man. Invariants: preserve the entire body from the neck downward unchanged. Preserve the complete existing head-to-upper-thigh framing, pose, character scale and placement. Do not move shoulders, arms, clothing, hands, flowers or body. No hat, no mask, no jacket, no props, no accessories added.
Background: remove the dark/brown backdrop and any glow around the body completely; background must be real alpha transparency, including between hair strands and fingers, with no matte shadow, haze, dark halo, floor or vignette. Keep all opaque portions of the character fully opaque. No fake checkerboard background, no text, no watermark.
